"""Recurring nonuniform allgather compiler.

Builds weighted logical out-trees over the participant set together with
compressed physical unicast routes (serial-route recipes) for the offered
envelope, or produces a checkable negative witness (strict deficient cut).

Model notes
-----------
* A recipe concatenation junction must not be a participant, so every emitted
  route walk has an interior that avoids participants entirely.  The compiler
  therefore works on a "split" copy of the fabric in which each participant is
  duplicated into an emission half and a reception half that are not connected:
  every split-graph path from an emission half to a reception half corresponds
  exactly to a physical walk whose interior contains no participant.
* Ordinary forwarding vertices never replicate or aggregate: only participants
  branch, which the logical trees express.  Every logical send is charged as
  separate unicast traffic on the physical walks.
"""

import random
import time

from flow import maxflow, decompose, widest, mincut, BIG

MAX_TREES = 8192
MAX_ROUTES = 32768
MAX_RECIPE_NODES = 65536


class Fabric:
    """Directed physical arcs plus the participant split graph."""

    def __init__(self, n, linkuv, cap, participants):
        self.n = n
        self.linkuv = linkuv
        self.cap = cap
        self.parcs = []          # (frm, to, link, direction)
        self.pcap = []
        for l, (u, v) in enumerate(linkuv):
            c = cap[l]
            if c <= 0:
                continue
            self.parcs.append((u, v, l, 0))
            self.pcap.append(c)
            self.parcs.append((v, u, l, 1))
            self.pcap.append(c)
        part = set(participants)
        self.idx = {}
        for i, v in enumerate(participants):
            self.idx[v] = (n + 2 * i, n + 2 * i + 1)
        self.sarc = []           # split arc -> (a, b)
        self.s2p = []            # split arc -> physical arc index
        for i, (frm, to, l, d) in enumerate(self.parcs):
            a = self.idx[frm][0] if frm in part else frm
            b = self.idx[to][1] if to in part else to
            self.sarc.append((a, b))
            self.s2p.append(i)
        self.snodes = n + 2 * len(participants)
        self.sadj = [[] for _ in range(self.snodes)]
        self.eto = [0] * (2 * len(self.sarc))
